name: Poly Cubed 2018
information:
The incredible sequel to 2017's hit competition, Poly^3 2018 will have more competitors, more cubes, and 5x5!

This competition will be held on the campus of International Polytechnic High School and hosted through the Strategic Gaming Club. All earnings will go towards the Strategic Gaming Club.
Special thanks to SpeedCubeShop for sponsoring this competition!
